grh_2a2ed243a61aec1ac991.title: The Long Lane
paragraphs: Gladys Brooks has built a new life with her young son Jackie and plans to marry Jerry Connor after years of separation from her husband Jeffrey. A War Department telegram suddenly reports that Jeffrey, long believed lost, has been found alive in China. Jackie is thrilled to learn that his father served in the war, while Gladys is forced to face feelings she thought were over. When Jeffrey returns, crippled but changed, he tells Dr. Christian that he had left Gladys because he believed he was selfish and useless, then found purpose fighting in China and learned to live for other people. Convinced Gladys loves Jerry, Jeffrey plans to leave rather than stand in her way. Gladys overhears him, realizes she still loves her husband, and asks his forgiveness. Jerry quietly withdraws as the separated couple reunites and Jackie gets his father back.

This [[show|dr-christian|Dr. Christian]] broadcast aired on November 14, 1945. It is listed as episode 364 in the archive. [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Jean Hersholt and Rosemary De Camp. Other credited names include Bob Anderson as announcer.
The surviving recording runs about 25 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.b199d95f77b6c241|Vaseline]].

grh_2a9a2f52bee710cde32b.title: Words at War 43-09-23 (15) They Shall Not Have Me
paragraphs: French prisoner John Hélion survives forced labor in Germany by clinging to one purpose: escape. Fellow prisoners pool maps, money, clothing, forged papers and hard-won knowledge from failed attempts, even disciplining a suspected informer to protect future plans. Hélion finally slips away in civilian disguise and travels through Germany by train, repeatedly risking exposure at inspections and among strangers. Near the border, sympathetic travelers help shield him, and he reaches freedom, dedicating his escape to the comrades whose collective effort made it possible.

Other credited names include Joseph Losey as director, Kenneth White as radio adaptor, and Morris Mamorsky as radio adaptor.

grh_2a118f7c0afae8cbfb4c.title: Just Call Me Lucky
paragraphs: Ambitious operator Lucky Landers is determined to hurry to Fairbanks for a business deal despite repeated warnings from old Alaskans and a bush pilot that bad weather cannot be rushed. After the flight leaves them stranded in the wilderness, the pilot decides their only chance is to build a signal fire. Lucky pulls a gun rather than let him burn the papers in his briefcase, revealing that the papers are actually all the money he has made in Alaska. The pilot burns the cash anyway, a rescue plane spots the fire, and Lucky survives only by losing the fortune he was so desperate to protect.

grh_2a6fd064e0b63885df00.title: Hope Is a Woman
paragraphs: Charles Lounsberry loves Hope Morton, but when her father asks whether he would still marry her if he had only thirty days to live, Charles hesitates and loses Hope's respect. Hope's father and a doctor then make Charles believe he really has only a month left; the supposed deadline teaches him what matters, inspires a generous 'will' of life's simple joys, and sends him back to Hope ready to choose her for thirty seconds or thirty million years. The ruse is revealed and Hope accepts him.

grh_2aa390312b0e9acadbcd.title: Words at War 43-07-24 (05) the Ship
paragraphs: The British light cruiser HMS Artemis escorts a vital convoy through the Mediterranean while enemy aircraft, cruisers and battleships close in. Officers and ratings at every station struggle to keep the ship fighting as damage mounts and the captain balances protecting the convoy against the temptation to chase the enemy. Torpedoes, gunfire and disciplined damage control finally force the opposing force to turn away, allowing the convoy to continue. As darkness falls, the captain reflects that winning the battle is only part of the larger struggle and that preserving freedom will demand vigilance and purpose long after the shooting ends.

paragraphs: Rocky is mistaken for prizefighter Luis Gandolfo and forced into a bout that gamblers expect Gandolfo to throw. grh_2ac453fbcc22d3dc1372.title: Dr Knock
paragraphs: Dr. Knock buys a sleepy rural medical practice and sets out to teach the entire district that health is merely an illness not yet diagnosed. Free consultations, ominous examinations and carefully cultivated fear turn healthy villagers into paying patients until beds, hotels and households are organized around his treatments, astonishing the former doctor with Knock's ambition to put virtually the whole town under medical care.
